title: TD Marketing: booking Rocco's free call is the hand-over, and screens say who has the lead
text: The setter now passes a lead on by booking the free 15-minute call (a WhatsApp call, no Zoom) with a note for Rocco; booking it makes the lead Rocco's at once, and cancelling the call sends it back. Booked leads wait in one column, Calls prenotate, until Rocco chooses a result. A call whose time has passed (30 minutes after the start) gets a red "Call time passed" tag and sits at the top.
points: Gone: Pass to Rocco, the seller's Contacted step, Pick this lead, Give it back, and the Pick button on the Today page.
Screens now say who has the lead: With the setter, With you, With <name>.
Rocco sees the setter's booking note in the call box as "Note from the setter".
A missed call is Rocco's to follow up, with Not ready now or a note.
